title: Weak evolution for the canonical sphere coordinate equation

target_statement: For the specified integrated sphere diffusion, set $\rho_t=(X_t)_\#P$, $F(t)=\int f(w)\,d\rho_{t^+}(w)$ and $B(t)=\int\mathcal L_{t^+}f(w)\,d\rho_{t^+}(w)$. The generator average $B$ is locally integrable on the real line. The expectation $F$ is absolutely continuous on every finite nonnegative interval and satisfies the signed balance and ordinary derivative below.
